title: Buen City Pass
text:
I’ve used city passes in several destinations, so I was curious to try the Barcelona City Pass in my own city — and I wasn’t disappointed. It covers many of the main attractions, plus the hop-on hop-off tour bus, which is a fun way to rediscover the city. Booking and using the pass was simple: everything came by email and worked perfectly on my phone.

Some popular places, such as the Sagrada Família and Park Güell, do require booking in advance, so it is worth planning ahead.

title: It paid off!
text:
